bayts.text: Upon the Chosen One, the Best of creatures, Muḥammad, make Your peace everlasting, O my God, with (hosts of) praisers.
O Effacer (al-Māḥī, Muḥammad), from before the year Hakshash (1325 AH / 1907-08), of what was evil, through grace, honour, glory and lordship.
Your privileges of nobility the assembly (of the learned) enumerated before me, and they grew weary: and the one who strives is not like one who plays.
My Lord has guided through you everyone who sought His guidance: upon you be the blessing of Allah, O best of the rightly guided.
Your Book is for me treasure, rank and elevation; and whoever pleases your Lord with the Qurʾān is guided.
The peace of Him Who raised you, O best (Book) sent down, upon the best envoy to creation, the rightly guiding.
I have thanked Allah for you with a gratitude that increases me; and whoever through you turns to gratitude, O Remembrance (the Qurʾān), is rightly guided.
The success of whoever recites you remains everlasting, up to the lofty Garden, without hesitation.
My certainty guards me from forsaking you, forever, O Guidance; through you my Lord has effaced, without return, my wasting away.
The gain of whoever recites you is the gain of one given glad tidings; and whoever through you seeks success, O Remembrance, is made happy.
Through you Allah has given me safety from harm, among everyone who draws near and everyone far off.
The Everlasting leads to me through you my request, (I) in safety; and whoever through you seeks victory, O Remembrance, is succoured.
I have known with certainty that you are the good and the guidance; and whoever seeks everlasting glory is glorified through you.
Through you I seek my needs from the best Sender-down (of Revelation), and for me, through you, (He) has already fulfilled my need, without (any) corrupter.
Toward others than me harm has turned, in this world and the next; Allah, through you, has spared me my enviers without encounter.
To me Allah reveals the unseen whenever I wish it, through you, today, O Qurʾān of my Lord, and tomorrow.
When I seek my request from my Lord through you, I obtain it; through you Allah has made my abiding pure for me with the greatest ease.
I have inherited you, O Qurʾān of my Lord, by His grace (Qurʾān 35:32): whoever does not agree with me is driven off toward others than me.
My love (goes) to an Everlasting One Who sent down the Remembrance, firmly set, upon him through whom no rebel has come near me.
By Your Face, on my behalf, bless, my Lord, with peace, the Best of all Allah's creation, Muḥammad.
